content.title: System Overview
content.content: The ControlLogix 5000 series is a high-performance modular PLC platform designed for complex automation applications. It supports up to 32,000 I/O points, 100+ communication modules, and integrated motion control. The platform uses a common control engine across all controllers, enabling seamless migration and code reuse.

content.title: Hardware Architecture
content.content: The ControlLogix chassis uses a high-speed backplane (1.5 Gbps) supporting up to 17 slots. Controllers (1756-L7x/L8x) feature dual-core processors, 4-80 MB user memory, and integrated EtherNet/IP ports. I/O modules are hot-swappable with electronic keying. Redundancy modules (1756-RM2) provide bumpless failover.

subsections.title: Chassis Types
subsections.content: Available chassis: 1756-A4 (4-slot), 1756-A7 (7-slot), 1756-A10 (10-slot), 1756-A13 (13-slot), 1756-A17 (17-slot). All support standard and controlled environment ratings.

subsections.title: Controller Comparison
subsections.content: 1756-L71 (2MB), L72 (4MB), L73 (8MB), L74 (16MB), L75 (32MB) - 5570 series. 1756-L81E (4MB), L82E (8MB), L83E (16MB), L84E (32MB), L85E (80MB) - 5580 series with integrated safety.

content.title: Supported Programming Languages
content.content: ControlLogix supports four IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder Diagram (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block Diagram (FBD), and Sequential Function Chart (SFC). Also supports C/C++ via the Open Development Kit (ODK) for custom algorithms.

subsections.title: Ladder Diagram (LD)
subsections.content: Primary language for boolean logic. Supports branches, subroutines, AOI (Add-On Instructions), and online editing. Use XIC, XIO, OTE, OTL, OTU, TON, TOF, RTO, CTU, CTD, RES instructions.

subsections.title: Structured Text (ST)
subsections.content: Pascal-like language for complex math, string handling, and algorithms. Supports IF-THEN-ELSE, CASE, FOR, WHILE, REPEAT loops. Ideal for recipes, data manipulation, and motion profiles.

content.title: Communication Protocols
content.content: Native EtherNet/IP (CIP) on controller. Supports DeviceNet, ControlNet, DH+, Remote I/O via communication modules. CIP Motion, CIP Safety, CIP Sync for time synchronization. OPC UA server built-in (5580 series).

content.title: Integrated Motion Control
content.content: CIP Motion supports up to 100 axes per controller. Supports servo, stepper, and induction motors. Features: electronic gearing, camming, position capture, coordinated motion (linear/circular interpolation), safety-rated monitored stop.

content.title: Integrated Safety (GuardLogix)
content.content: 5580 series controllers (L8xE) include SIL 3 / PLe safety. Separate safety memory, safety task, and safety I/O. Safety instructions: E-stop, guard monitoring, safety mat, two-hand control, speed monitoring. Safety signature for validation.

content.title: Troubleshooting & Diagnostics
content.content: Controller status indicators: RUN (green), I/O (green), FORCE (amber), FAULT (red). Major faults: Type 01-0F (hardware), Type 10-1F (I/O), Type 20-2F (communication), Type 30-3F (program). Use GSV/SSV for system values. Fault routine executes on major faults.

content.title: Best Practices
content.content: Use AOIs for reusable code. Organize with programs/routines. Use UDTs for structured data. Enable keying on I/O modules. Document with rung comments. Version control with Studio 5000 project files. Regular backup with .ACD files.

content.title: System Overview
content.content: The S7-1500 is Siemens' high-end modular controller for demanding automation tasks. Features: up to 20 MB program memory, 1 ns bit processing, integrated PROFINET (2-port switch), web server, OPC UA server, display, and SIMATIC memory card. Scalable from compact to high-performance CPUs.

content.title: CPU Portfolio
content.content: Standard CPUs: 1511-1 PN (150 KB), 1513-1 PN (300 KB), 1515-2 PN (500 KB), 1516-3 PN/DP (1 MB), 1517-3 PN/DP (2 MB), 1518-4 PN/DP (4 MB). Compact CPUs: 1511C, 1512C with onboard I/O. Technology CPUs: 1511T, 1515T, 1517T with motion control. F-CPU variants for safety (SIL 3).

content.title: TIA Portal Engineering
content.content: Total Integrated Automation Portal for unified engineering. Hardware configuration, programming (LAD, FBD, STL, SCL, GRAPH), diagnostics, commissioning. Multi-user engineering, version control integration, libraries, hardware detection.

content.title: PROFINET Communication
content.content: Integrated 2-port PROFINET switch (RT/IRT). Supports: IO Controller, IO Device, I-Device, Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP), Shared Device, Isochronous Real Time (IRT) for motion. Up to 256 IO Devices. Topology: line, star, ring.

content.title: Integrated Web Server
content.content: Access via standard browser (HTTP/HTTPS). Features: CPU status, diagnostics buffer, module info, firmware update, file browser, user pages (HTML/JavaScript), watch tables, trace. Custom web applications via Web API. Authentication: user management with roles.

content.title: OPC UA Server
content.content: Built-in OPC UA server (DA/HA/AC). Companion specifications: ADI, Robotics, PackML. Security: certificates, signing, encryption. Information modeling with nodesets. Alarms & Conditions, Historical Access, PubSub. Performance: up to 10,000 monitored items.

content.title: Technology Objects & Motion Control
content.content: Technology objects: positioning axis, synchronous axis, external encoder, measuring input, output cam, cam track. PLCopen Motion Control instructions (MC_Power, MC_MoveAbsolute, MC_GearIn, MC_CamIn). Up to 128 axes (CPU dependent). Kinematics for robots.

content.title: Safety Integrated (F-CPU)
content.content: Fail-safe CPUs up to SIL 3 (IEC 61508) / PL e (ISO 13849). Safety program in separate memory area. PROFIsafe for distributed safety I/O. Safety instructions: ESTOP, Two-Hand, Safety Door, Light Curtain, Muting, Speed Monitoring. Safety administration: password, validation, CRC.

content.title: M580 ePAC Overview
content.content: The Modicon M580 is an Ethernet PAC (Programmable Automation Controller) with unified Ethernet backbone. Features: dual-core CPU, 16-64 MB memory, integrated Ethernet switch, cybersecurity (Achilles Level 2), hot standby redundancy, 4000+ I/O. Programmed with Unity Pro / EcoStruxure Control Expert.

content.title: Ethernet Architecture
content.content: Single Ethernet network for I/O, HMI, SCADA, IT. RSTP ring topology (<50ms recovery). DIO (Distributed I/O) via EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP. CIP Safety for safety I/O. QoS for traffic prioritization. Network Time Protocol (NTP) synchronization.

content.title: Hot Standby Redundancy
content.content: Primary/Standby CPU pair with automatic switchover (<50ms). Shared memory for state synchronization. Redundant Ethernet modules (BMEH582040). Supports: bumpless transfer, configuration sync, online modification. Requires: matched CPUs, same firmware, redundant power supplies.

content.title: Unity Pro / EcoStruxure Control Expert
content.content: IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block (FBD), Instruction List (IL), Sequential Function Chart (SFC). Advanced: DFBs (Derived Function Blocks), EFBs (Elementary Function Blocks), DDTs (Derived Data Types). Features: simulation, online changes, cross-references, documentation generator.

content.title: Cybersecurity Features
content.content: Achilles Level 2 certified. Features: signed firmware, secure boot, port disabling, IP filtering, user authentication (local/RADIUS/LDAP), role-based access (RBAC), audit logging, encrypted communication (TLS), certificate management. Compliance: IEC 62443, NERC CIP.

content.title: Integrated Safety
content.content: M580 Safety (BMEP58xx040) with SIL 3 / PL e. Separate safety CPU core. Safety I/O via CIP Safety on Ethernet. Safety programming in Unity Pro with safety library. Safety functions: E-stop, guard monitoring, safety mat, two-hand, speed/position monitoring. Safety signature and validation.
